name: Repair a cross-warp shared-memory exchange
description: Exactly one CTA of 64 threads. Two disjoint global arrays of 64 uint32 values, at least 256 bytes each. Thread t writes input[t] to shared exchange[t], then reads exchange[t xor 32] into output[t]. Expected output[t] = input[(t+32)%64]. Every thread reaches the same straight-line instructions. Keep the entry ABI, arithmetic, memory operations, launch and all assumptions unchanged. Only insert/remove standalone bar.sync 0 instructions. Numerical equivalence and GPU execution are not tested by this task.
